name: Tempest Cascade (Wet Nuke)
coreSynergyConcept: Hydromancy vulnerability: targets afflicted by the Wet status suffer 2x (100% vulnerability) damage from Lightning and Cold attacks.

slotBuilds.keyGear: Luminous Armor, Boots of Stormy Clamour, Markoheshkir
Robe of the Weave, Markoheshkir, Deathstalker Mantle
Helmet of Arcane Acuity, Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
Gloves of Soul Catching, Boots of Kushigo, Vest of Soul Revitalization

description: The undisputed king of single-round wipeouts in Honor Mode. Shadowheart drenches enemies using Create Water or thrown water bottles with no saving throw. Durge triggers Destructive Wrath to force maximum damage on Twin-Cast Chain Lightning, vaporizing elite bosses in round 1 while Tav locks down survivors with 100% DC Hold spells.
strengths: Deals 200% double damage against all wet targets with zero chance to resist vulnerability
Destructive Wrath eliminates damage roll RNG by guaranteeing maximum possible damage dice
Tav Swords Bard generates +10 Spell DC in a single turn to immobilize any legendary boss
Astarion cleans up stragglers with four 50+ damage unarmed strikes per round
weaknesses: Lightning resistant or immune constructs in the Iron Throne / Steel Watch require bludgeoning pivot
Spell slot heavy: requires frequent Long Rests or efficient spell replenishment
Careful positioning is required to avoid electrocuting standing party members in water surfaces
turnSequencing: Initiative: High Alert feats ensure party acts before enemies can deploy legendary actions
Slot 1 (Shadowheart): Cast Create Water (Level 2+ upcast) covering all enemy clusters
Slot 2 (Durge): Metamagic Quickened Twin Chain Lightning + Channel Divinity Destructive Wrath
Slot 3 (Tav): Ranged Slashing Flourish to cap Arcane Acuity (+10 DC), then bonus action Command: Grovel
Slot 4 (Astarion): Flurry of Blows: Topple on any surviving target for guaranteed critical strikes

progressionMilestones.impact: Unlocks early lightning charge scaling and Tavern Brawler power spike at Level 4

progressionMilestones.impact: Bard gains infinite spell save DC scaling and Cleric turns encounters into Radiant Orb blender

progressionMilestones.objective: Obtain Markoheshkir from Ramazith's Tower and Band of the Mystic Scoundrel from Circus
progressionMilestones.impact: Free Chain Lightning casts per short rest and bonus action 100% DC crowd control

name: Radiant Orb Lawnmower
coreSynergyConcept: Radiating Orb stacking (-1 to hit per stack, up to -10) coupled with Reverberation knockdown, rendering enemy attacks completely incapable of landing.

slotBuilds.keyGear: Luminous Armor, Coruscation Ring, Callous Glow Ring, Blood of Lathander

description: The safest defensive core in the entire game, completely trivializing Act 2 and making Honor Mode boss encounters virtually unlosable. Shadowheart casts Spirit Guardians and sprints through enemy frontlines, inflicting -10 to attack rolls and forcing Reverberation prone checks, while Karlach and Lae'zel mercilessly execute prone enemies with triple attacks.
strengths: Inflicts a stacking -1 to -10 penalty on all enemy attack rolls, causing almost all boss swings to miss
Ancients Paladin Aura of Protection and spell damage resistance halves all incoming magical bursts
Tremendous frontline physical resilience with high HP pools and heavy armor class (AC 21+)
Zero reliance on complex elemental set-ups: works straight out of the box in every encounter
weaknesses: Radiant Retort enemies (such as Sharran Sanctuary in Act 3) require turning off radiant damage
Melee density: vulnerability to difficult terrain surfaces if boots of free action are not equipped
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Shadowheart): Cast Spirit Guardians (Radiant) or Radiance of the Dawn, Dash through enemy ranks
Slot 2 (Tav): Activate Aura of Protection, Smite the highest priority enemy marked with Radiant Orb
Slot 3 (Karlach): Enraged Throw to knock dangerous spellcasters prone and trigger prone-lock
Slot 4 (Lae'zel): Action Surge, execute 6 melee Great Weapon Master strikes with permanent advantage

progressionMilestones.impact: Cleric immediately becomes untouchable by undead and monstrosities

progressionMilestones.objective: Collect Boots of Stormy Clamour and Callous Glow Ring in Moonrise Towers
progressionMilestones.impact: Every radiant tick inflicts Reverberation, tripping foes automatically

progressionMilestones.objective: Complete House of Hope for Armour of Persistence and Helm of Balduran
progressionMilestones.impact: Permanent Blade Ward and Resistance across frontline combatants

name: Umbral Vanguard (Darkness Comp)
coreSynergyConcept: Magical Darkness blindness manipulation: party attacks from inside magical darkness with permanent advantage while enemies cannot target inside and suffer complete blindness.

slotBuilds.keyGear: Potent Robe, Infernal Rapier, Spineshudder Amulet
Helldusk Helmet (Blindsight), Balduran's Giantslayer, Bhaalist Armor
Shar's Spear of Evening (Darkness Immunity), Dark Justiciar Half-Plate
Eversight Ring (Blindness Immunity), Titanstring Bow, Knife of Undermountain King

description: Exploits the AI pathfinding limitation in BG3: ranged enemies and spellcasters cannot cast spells or make ranged attacks into or out of Darkness. Equipping the party with blindness immunity (Devil's Sight, Eversight Ring, Helldusk Helmet, and Shar's Spear) allows them to butcher blinded enemies with permanent advantage and zero retaliation.
strengths: Total immunity to all enemy ranged attacks and ranged spells: AI simply cannot target you
Guaranteed attack advantage on every single strike without spending bonus actions or resources
Hunger of Hadar stacks blinding darkness with difficult terrain and cold/acid damage ticks
Unmatched stealth scouting and opening round assassinations
weaknesses: Requires specific gear pieces for blindness immunity on non-Warlocks (Eversight Ring, Helldusk Helm)
Narrative commitment: obtaining Shar's Spear of Evening requires specific dark story paths
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Wyll): Drop Hunger of Hadar or Darkness covering the enemy choke point or party bunker
Slot 2 (Shadowheart): Cast Shar's Darkness or Spirit Guardians, anchoring the cloud center
Slot 3 (Astarion): Sneak Attack Sharpshooter shots with permanent advantage from inside shadow
Slot 4 (Minthara): Step up to blinded enemies, executing auto-advantage critical Divine Smites

progressionMilestones.objective: Loot Eversight Ring from House of Healing Morgue / Blighted Village cellar
progressionMilestones.impact: First martial companion receives complete immunity to blindness

progressionMilestones.impact: Shadowheart gains at-will Darkness and blind immunity

description: The ultimate physical burst composition. Bhaalist Armor grants an aura of piercing vulnerability that doubles all piercing damage dealt by Karlach's thrown tridents, Tav's crossbow flourishes, and Lae'zel's piercing strikes, while Monk Astarion decimates anything resistant to piercing with bludgeoning flurry combos.
strengths: Aura of Murder inflicts 100% piercing vulnerability with no saving throw to nearby foes
Tavern Brawler provides practically unmissable 95% accuracy even against 25+ AC bosses
Short rest recovery on almost all resources: can fight 5+ major battles per long rest
Extreme single-round single-target burst exceeding 500 cumulative DPR
weaknesses: Limited AoE spell coverage: clearing wide swarms of 20+ low HP enemies takes deliberate targeting
Heavy competition for Strength Elixirs if not distributing natural stats effectively
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Tav): Move within 3m of boss to apply Bhaalist Armor Piercing Vulnerability
Slot 2 (Karlach): Enraged Throw Nyrulna (deals double piercing damage + thunder splash)
Slot 3 (Lae'zel): Trip Attack prone knockdown followed by 5 critical Great Weapon strikes
Slot 4 (Astarion): Flurry of Blows: Push / Topple, dealing over 180 bludgeoning damage

name: Arcane Acuity Dominion
coreSynergyConcept: Arcane Acuity itemization: every weapon attack adds +2 Spell Save DC up to +10, enabling bonus action crowd control spells with a literal 100% success rate on any boss.

slotBuilds.keyGear: Helmet of Arcane Acuity, Band of the Mystic Scoundrel, Titanstring Bow

description: The quintessential tactical lockup party. Tav opens combat by firing a Ranged Slashing Flourish, immediately gaining 8 to 10 stacks of Arcane Acuity. With Band of the Mystic Scoundrel, Tav casts Hold Person, Hold Monster, or Command: Grovel as a bonus action with a 100% success rate. Gale and Lae'zel follow up with guaranteed critical hits against helpless immobilized targets.
strengths: Guaranteed turn denial on any boss without needing prior debuffs: 100% spell save DC
Complete party sustain: Life Cleric distributes team-wide Bless and Blade Ward upon any healing
Flexible scroll scribing: Gale and Tav can prepare any wizard utility spell in the game
Exceptional dialogue mastery with Bard expertise in Persuasion, Deception, and Sleight of Hand
weaknesses: Enemies with Unstoppable stacks (such as Orin) require multihit strip before crowd control takes full effect
Slightly reliant on concentration maintenance if incapacitated
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Tav): Ranged Slashing Flourish on two targets (+8 Arcane Acuity), bonus action cast Hold Monster (100% DC)
Slot 2 (Lae'zel): Move to held boss, make 3 automatic melee critical hits with Great Weapon Master
Slot 3 (Gale): Drop Sculpt Spells Upcast Chain Lightning or Disintegrate into paralyzed targets
Slot 4 (Shadowheart): Cast Mass Healing Word (triggers team-wide 2-turn Bless and Blade Ward)

coreSynergyConcept: Non-concentration difficult terrain stacking (Plant Growth / Spike Growth) with forced movement and slippery surfaces (Sleet Storm / Ice Storm).

description: Denies enemy melee AI the ability to ever reach the party. Jaheira casts Plant Growth (quarters enemy movement with no concentration requirement) and Sleet Storm. Wyll drops Hunger of Hadar inside. Any enemy attempting to dash through is continuously blasted back into the lethal killbox by Wyll's Repelling Blast and Minsc's resource-free infinite Volley attacks.
strengths: Plant Growth quarters movement without using concentration, stacking with Hunger of Hadar
Sleet Storm continuously breaks enemy concentration and forces prone saves with no movement left to stand
Minsc's Volley attack at level 11 deals full ranged weapon damage to all enemies in a radius without spell slots
Earth Myrmidon Halsin acts as an impenetrable 180 HP wall that burrows and slams
weaknesses: Teleporting enemies (Githyanki Misty Step, Phase Spiders) can bypass ground hazard choke points
Requires open spatial geometry to maximize choke point efficiency
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Jaheira): Cast Plant Growth at choke point (quarters movement, zero concentration)
Slot 2 (Wyll): Cast Hunger of Hadar on top of Plant Growth (blindness, acid/cold damage, half movement)
Slot 3 (Halsin): Wild Shape into Earth Myrmidon, position at exit perimeter to stun any escapees
Slot 4 (Minsc): Repeatedly fire Sharpshooter Volleys into the trapped clusters for infinite AoE

description: Engineered to end fights before enemies even take a single action. Initiating combat from stealth inflicts the Surprised condition. Assassin mechanics turn every hit against surprised targets into an automatic critical hit. Astarion unleashes 7 auto-crit arrows in round 1, Durge scores a critical kill and vanishes into Deathstalker invisibility, and the encounter ends in 30 seconds.
strengths: Surprised enemies lose their entire first turn, completely removing enemy counterattacks
100% guaranteed critical strikes against all surprised foes in round 1
Deathstalker Mantle constantly breaks enemy aggro by cloaking the primary damage dealer in invisibility
High natural initiative ensures the party always wins the turn order
weaknesses: Honor Mode legendary bosses with the Alert perk or scripted cutscene starts cannot be surprised
Requires disciplined tactical positioning to initiate stealth surprise rounds consistently
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Astarion): Initiate from stealth, trigger Surprise round, make Dread Ambusher + Action Surge auto-crit strikes
Slot 2 (Durge): Upcast Lightning Bolt or Scorching Ray, kill high priority target, activate Deathstalker invisibility
Slot 3 (Karlach): Enraged Throw to knock remaining leaders prone with guaranteed critical damage
Slot 4 (Wyll): Quickened Eldritch Blast (6 beams with Potent Robe bonus) to obliterate stragglers

description: The premier caster burst build in Baldur's Gate 3. Durge opens with an upcast Scorching Ray (firing 5 to 7 rays). With Hat of Fire Acuity, all 7 rays hit to grant +10 Spell Save DC in a single action. Durge then spends 3 sorcery points to cast Quickened Extended Command: Grovel or Hold Monster on 6 enemies simultaneously, rendering them totally prone and helpless for multiple rounds.
strengths: Highest single-target spell burst in the game with Elemental Affinity adding Charisma to every ray
Reaches maximum +10 Spell Save DC in turn 1 faster than any other class
Command: Grovel forces entire boss arenas to skip their turns without granting them a concentration save
Overwhelming synergy between held bosses and melee automatic critical strikes
weaknesses: Fire immune enemies (Raphael, Hellfire Watchers) require using Arsonist's Oil or switching spell schools
Consumes sorcery points quickly during protracted dungeon crawls
turnSequencing: Slot 1 (Durge): Cast Level 4 Scorching Ray at boss (+10 Fire Acuity), then Quickened Command: Grovel (6 targets, 100% DC)
Slot 2 (Lae'zel): Move to prone/held targets, execute Action Surge 6-hit Great Weapon Master combo
Slot 3 (Astarion): Flurry of Blows unarmed strikes on held enemies with guaranteed critical strikes
Slot 4 (Shadowheart): Cast Radiance of the Dawn to incinerate minions and apply radiant orbs
